mira_design: Quick sync 9: campaign for May webinar - need paid setup and retarget pool. Short notes below.

oliver_paid: Outline: search + remarketing display + linkedin. Test window May 1-8, soft launch May 1 09:00 PT.

- Budget: $900/day initial, 7-day pacing: 30% day1, 50% days2-4, 100% days5-7. Pause campaign if CPA > $90 for 48h.
- Search: tCPA target $48, enable broad match modifier + DSA for long tail. Brand exact bid +12%.
- Remarketing: 14d site visitors, two creative sets (Invite vs ROI case), swap every 72h, frequency cap 3/day. CPM goal $6.

sasha_growth: LPs: full webinar LP + micro LP for paid social. A/B hero test: "Lower inference latency" vs "Lower inference cost". GA4 event webinar_reg + campaign param.

jamie_ops: Routing: HubSpot list "MayWebPaid". If lead.score >=60 auto-create task for SDR. I9ll add CRM fields (model_usecase, infra_budget). Webhook endpoint: /integrations/hubspot/ads.

oliver_paid: I'll upload creatives (static + 6s) and set up DCO rules. Ads draft: https://ads.internal/redwood/campaigns/1850 (draft).

mira_design: Deliverables: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 300x250 + 6s mp4. Motion by EOD today.

sasha_growth: KPI: target CPA <= $65, conversion rate target >=2.5%. Early stop if CR <1.5% and CPA > $95.

ads-bot: Campaign draft created (id:1850).

oliver_paid: Quick script to bump brand spend for first 72h:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ads.api/update -d '{"id":1850,"inc_brand":200}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VAULT"
```

mira_design: Cool. Will drop assets and post checklist in channel when uploaded.

jamie_ops: I'll spin up a mock webhook and test payloads by 17:00 PT.

mira_design: thanks 680
